answer: Require each new identity to post a bond that only unlocks after it climbs a ridge of six consecutive epochs with passing, non-kin-graded answers. A sybil farm must then lock fresh capital per head and pay for original generations every epoch, so its costs grow linearly while per-head rewards stay flat. Keys that wander between operators are merged by shared vault links, and any referral inlet from kin accounts pays zero, so spawning clones never breaks even.
